newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures rally with bonds post CPI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures rally with bonds post CPI.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures rallied with bonds in brisk early trading, fueled by benign U.S. inflation data.
The March core consumer price index rose 0.2 percent and the overall index rose 0.1 percent, below forecasts.

Treasury bond futures shot almost a point higher on the data, and when June Standard and Poor's 500 futures opened an hour and ten minutes later, they surged the opening seven-point upside limit. June S&Ps extended their gains to post a fresh session high of 759.40, more than 10.00 points higher.
It was fast market trading early.

But one trader called the early buying frenzy "controlled," and said activity had tapered off a bit by 0935 CDT/1435 GMT. He said locals had emerged as sellers just below 758.00, but said intraday support near 756.00 should keep a floor under the local selling.
Traders put resistance levels at 760.00, 763.00 and 765.80.

"I'm mildly bullish on the session, but I think you have to carefully sell rallies," another S&P 500 futures trader said. He said June could have a bit more upside given the magnitude of recent losses, but he said his overall target remained at 735.00.
"I think you've got one last ditch effort by the bond market to rally, but the market is headed lower," he said.
He noted June S&P 500 short-covering from institutional traders.
Another trader pegged resistance at 760.00, but cautioned that the recent wild moves in June S&Ps makes it difficult to determine support and resistance.
"Given the 12- and 15-point days we've had, breaking out is not out of the question," he said.
June began the move on Monday, when the market rallied late amid the notion worries of a strong CPI were overdone.
Strong quarterly earnings from Intel Corp also bolstered bulls, traders said.

At 0957 CDT/1457 GMT, June S&P 500s were up 9.60 points at 756.90, Nasdaq 100s rose 0.15 points to 816.00, Russell 2000s were up 3.40 points at 344.75, KCBT Value Line futures rallied 8.85 points to 690.25, Nikkei 225 index futures rose 355.0 to 18,095.0 and Midcap 400s gained 2.80 points to 254.90.
